# `project.drawing.set`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/project.drawing.set.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`project.drawing.set` (`SetDrawing`): writes the drawing settings `settings.extra.drawing` (doc 03 §5.1).

The given members are merged into the object: a value sets the member, `null` removes it; members of the
object this command does not know are kept. An object left empty is removed. `crossings` (`plain` or `hops`,
FR-CON-031) chooses how crossing wires are drawn; absent means plain. Presentation only: no derived value
changes (the drawing of crossings reads it). Rejected: a `drawing` member of the project settings that is not an
object (a newer or damaged format; the command never overwrites it); an unknown value (invalid); no member
given (invalid at the root). Interactive. Outcome: none.

## Types

### Crossings

How crossing wires are drawn (FR-CON-031).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"plain"` | Plain crossings (the default). |
| `"hops"` | The wire of the rule hops over the other. |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
